neighbours.label: the words ' lip' / ' lips' (the mouth's lips and lip cosmetics)
fire: She pressed her lips together and said nothing.
Use a lip liner before applying the colour.
His upper lip was swollen after the fall.
A soft pink lip tint suits most skin tones.
Her lips were chapped from the cold wind.
The baby's lower lip trembled before she cried.
Our new lip scrub removes dry, flaky skin.
He wiped the foam off his lips with a napkin.
quiet: She pressed her hands together and said nothing.
Use an eye liner before applying the colour.
His left knee was swollen after the fall.
A soft pink blush suits most skin tones.
Her hands were chapped from the cold wind.
The baby's tiny chin trembled before she cried.
Our new foot scrub removes dry, flaky skin.
He wiped the foam off his beard with a napkin.

notes: Positive pole is eyebrows/eyelashes. Probes: 'lip gloss' 0.55, 'Lip balm' 0.51, 'Her lips curled' 0.38, 'licked his lips' 0.05, lipstick 0.17.
